| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Smallest sigma** `minSigma` | 1 | 0.5 to 50 px | The smallest scale. Blobs smaller than the matching radius are missed. |
| **Largest sigma** `maxSigma` | 30 | 1 to 100 px | The largest scale. scikit-image uses 30. If it is below the smallest sigma, only the smallest is used. |
| **Number of scales** `numSigma` | 10 | 2 to 50 | How many scales are tried between the smallest and the largest sigma. |
| **Logarithmic scales** `logScale` | off | On or off | Space the scales evenly in log sigma instead of in sigma, so small scales are tried more closely. |
| **Threshold** `threshold` | 0.01 | 0 to 0.2 | The smallest determinant a blob needs, for an image from 0 to 1. scikit-image uses 0.01. |
| **Overlap** `overlap` | 0.5 | 0 to 1 | Of two blobs whose areas overlap by more than this share, the smaller goes. 1 keeps all. |
